title: Cure for Zombkolaps Invented!
author: Zombie Containment (ZC) Labs Inc
pages: Years of ZC Lab research culminated in our generation’s greatest achievement: The Cure for Zombkolaps. Sacrifices of so many people paid off for this cure.
We present the cure for Zombkolaps. This works for all three stages of disease but we recommend applying as soon as possible.
Firstly, you need to weaken the diseases by splashing a potion of weakness on the patient. Then, you need to feed the patient a golden apple.
If the patient is in the first two phases, they should almost immediately recover. However, if the patient became a zombie, it takes a while for them to convert back.
Warning: At this time, when someone is converting back from a zombie, they are often stronger and more dangerous, as their body unrots.
